★firstDttm(같은 품목 최초 업로드일시) — 종전에는 행마다 상관 서브쿼리로 같은 테이블을 다시 뒤졌다. -- 4,562행 조회에서 이 한 칸이 871ms 를 먹었다(944ms → 73ms, 2026-07-25 실측). -- 윈도우 함수로 한 번에 계산한다(=167ms). 파티션 범위는 종전과 동일 — 기간·ACTION_YN 과 무관하게 -- 같은 (출고일자+출고장+사업장+품목)의 전체 최소값이라 아래 t 서브쿼리 안에서 먼저 계산해야 한다. t.firstDttm, t.DC_CD AS dcCd, t.DC_NM AS dcNm, t.VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd, t.VENDOR_NM AS vendorNm, t.ITEM_CD AS itemCd, t.ITEM_NM AS itemNm, t.BIZ_CD AS bizCd, t.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, t.BOX_QTY AS boxQty, t.LABEL_QTY AS labelQty, t.UNPAID_LABEL_QTY AS unpaidLabelQty, t.INWH AS inwh, t.ZONE AS zone, t.BUS_NO AS busNo, t.RT_SEQ AS rtSeq, AS jumunNo, t.JUMUN_ITEM_NO AS jumunItemNo, -- ★판매단가 — 마감관리(selectClosing)와 똑같은 규칙(2026-07-25). 매출내역에서 정산서가 아직 안 온 -- 출고행의 매출금액을 이 단가로 채운다. 기준일은 마감과 같이 납품일자(DLV_DT). u.saleUnit, u.saleSrc FROM ( SELECT s0.*, CONVERT(varchar(19), MIN(s0.UPLOAD_DTTM) OVER (PARTITION BY s0.COMP_CD, s0.SHPOUT_DT, ISNULL(s0.DC_CD,''), ISNULL(s0.BIZ_CD,''), ISNULL(s0.ITEM_CD,'')), 120) AS firstDttm FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s0 ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PROD_CD, p.SALE_PRICE, p.COMP_CD FROM TBL_PROD_MST p WHERE p.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND p.PROD_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(p2.PROD_SEQ) FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.PROD_CD = p.PROD_CD AND p2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND p2.COMP_CD = p.COMP_CD) ) pm ON pm.PROD_CD = t.ITEM_CD AND pm.COMP_CD = t.COMP_CD OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 h.SALE_PRICE FROM TBL_PROD_SALEPRICE_HST h WHERE h.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND h.PROD_CD = t.ITEM_CD AND h.APPLY_DT <= t.DLV_DT AND h.COMP_CD = t.COMP_CD AND h.VENDOR_CD IS NULL -- 공통가만 (마감과 동일 — 판매처 전용가는 섞지 않는다) ORDER BY h.APPLY_DT DESC, h.SALEPRICE_SEQ DESC ) sh CROSS APPLY ( SELECT ISNULL(sh.SALE_PRICE, ISNULL(pm.SALE_PRICE,0)) AS saleUnit, CASE WHEN sh.SALE_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN '이력' ELSE '마스터' END AS saleSrc ) u WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND t.SHPOUT_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND t.SHPOUT_DT = REPLACE(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' ) ) ORDER BY t.SHPOUT_DT DESC, t.BIZ_NM, t.ITEM_NM, SELECT x.ym AS ym, x.dcCd AS dcCd, MAX(x.dcNm) AS dcNm, SUM(x.saleAmt) AS saleAmt, SUM(x.stlAmt) AS stlAmt, -- 그중 정산서 확정분 SUM(x.estAmt) AS estAmt, -- 그중 추정분(정산서 미도착) SUM(x.trxAmt) AS trxAmt, -- 그중 직접판매(전표) SUM(x.costAmt) AS costAmt, -- 매입액(원가) — 마감(selectClosing)과 같은 규칙 SUM(x.saleAmt) - SUM(x.costAmt) AS marginAmt -- 순마진 = 매출액 - 매입액 FROM ( -- ① 정산서 전체 (매출) -- ★매입액은 '출고 자료에 짝이 없는 정산서'(출고미상)에서만 잡는다. -- 짝이 있는 건의 매입액은 ②에서 출고수량 × 매입단가로 잡히므로 여기서 또 잡으면 이중계상이다. -- (마감 selectClosing 의 출고미상 블록과 같은 규칙 — 정산수량 × 매입단가로 추정) SELECT LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT),6) AS ym, dk.dcKey AS dcCd, ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'(미지정)') AS dcNm, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS stlAmt, 0 AS estAmt, 0 AS trxAmt, CASE WHEN ok.itemCd IS NULL THEN ISNULL(s.OUT_QTY,0) * ISNULL(ih.IN_PRICE, ISNULL(pm.IN_PRICE,0)) ELSE 0 END AS costAmt FROM TBL_SALES_MST s /* 출고장 키를 ②·마감과 같은 규칙(DC_CD 우선, 없으면 이름→코드)으로 통일한다. 2026-07-22 이전 정산서에는 DC_CD 가 없어, 코드만 보면 여러 출고장이 빈 코드 하나로 뭉쳤다. */ CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey, REPLACE(ISNULL(s.DLV_DT,''),'-','') AS dlvKey ) dk LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(ISNULL(o2.DLV_DT,''),'-','') AS dlvKey, CASE WHEN ISNULL(o2.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o2.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(o2.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(o2.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(o2.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(o2.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(o2.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(o2.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(o2.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey, ISNULL(o2.ITEM_CD,'') AS itemCd, o2.COMP_CD AS compCd FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST o2 WHERE o2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' ) ok ON ok.dlvKey = dk.dlvKey AND ok.dcKey = dk.dcKey AND ok.itemCd = ISNULL(s.ITEM_CD,'') AND ok.compCd = s.COMP_CD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PROD_CD, p.IN_PRICE, p.COMP_CD FROM TBL_PROD_MST p WHERE p.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND p.PROD_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(p2.PROD_SEQ) FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.PROD_CD = p.PROD_CD AND p2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND p2.COMP_CD = p.COMP_CD) ) pm ON pm.PROD_CD = s.ITEM_CD AND pm.COMP_CD = s.COMP_CD OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 h.IN_PRICE FROM TBL_PROD_INPRICE_HST h WHERE h.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND h.PROD_CD = s.ITEM_CD AND h.APPLY_DT <= dk.dlvKey AND h.COMP_CD = s.COMP_CD ORDER BY h.APPLY_DT DESC, h.INPRICE_SEQ DESC ) ih WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' UNION 의 첫 가지가 컬럼명을 정하므로 파생표 컬럼이 dt 가 아니라 ym 이 되어 바깥의 SELECT x.dt / GROUP BY x.dt 가 'Invalid column name dt' 로 죽었다(원장이 안 떴음). 게다가 이 가지만 월(6자리), 나머지는 일자(8자리)라 섞여 있었다. 일자로 통일한다. */ SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, 0 AS dcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS payAmt, 0 AS discAmt FROM TBL_SALES_MST s WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) IS NOT NULL AND s.DC_CD = ( SELECT MAX(v.DC_CD) FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST v WHERE v.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR v.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND v.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(v.DC_CD,'') <> '' ) UNION ALL -- 판매전표(정산서 밖에서 직접 판 건) — 거래처코드로 바로 붙는다 SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(t2.TOT_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, ISNULL(t2.DC_AMT,0) AS dcAmt, ISNULL(t2.PAY_AMT,0) AS rcvAmt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS payAmt, 0 AS discAmt FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_MST t2 WHERE t2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t2.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t2.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) UNION ALL SELECT m.PURCH_DT AS dt, 0 AS saleAmt, 0 AS dcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, ISNULL(m.TOT_AMT,0) AS purchAmt, ISNULL(m.PAY_AMT,0) AS payAmt, ISNULL(m.DC_AMT,0) AS discAmt FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND m.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) UNION ALL SELECT t.TRX_DT, 0, ISNULL(t.SALE_DC_AMT,0), CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB='RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB='PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, ISNULL(t.DC_AMT,0) FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) x GROUP BY x.dt ORDER BY x.dt

vm.VENDOR_CD AS custCd, vm.VENDOR_NM AS custNm, LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT),6) AS ym, ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, 0 AS saleDcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS purchDcAmt, 0 AS payAmt FROM TBL_SALES_MST s CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey ) dk -- 출고장 1곳에 거래처가 둘 이상 잡히면 매출이 두 배가 된다 → DC_CD 로 미리 1행으로 접는다 JOIN ( SELECT DC_CD, MIN(VENDOR_CD) AS VENDOR_CD, MIN(VENDOR_NM) AS VENDOR_NM FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(DC_CD,'') <> '' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY DC_CD ) vm ON vm.DC_CD = dk.dcKey WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL -- ③ 매입전표 — 매입 + 전표에 적힌 즉시지급 SELECT m.VENDOR_CD, m.VENDOR_NM, LEFT(m.PURCH_DT,6), m.PURCH_DT, 0, 0, 0, ISNULL(m.TOT_AMT,0), ISNULL(m.DC_AMT,0), ISNULL(m.PAY_AMT,0) FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
UNION ALL -- ④ 수금/지급 전표 — 같은 표에 TRX_GB 로 갈린다 SELECT t.CUST_CD, t.CUST_NM, LEFT(t.TRX_DT,6), t.TRX_DT, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.SALE_DC_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.DC_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) x WHERE ISNULL(x.custCd,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(x.ym,'') <> '' GROUP BY x.custCd, x.ym ) g LEFT JOIN TBL_VENDOR_MST v ON v.VENDOR_CD = g.custCd AND v.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR v.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ORDER BY g.custCd, g.ym

SELECT z.gb AS gb, z.gbNm AS gbNm, z.dt AS dt, z.docNo AS docNo, z.place AS place, z.itemCd AS itemCd, z.itemNm AS itemNm, z.qty AS qty, z.price AS price, z.amt AS amt, z.remark AS remark FROM ( -- ① 출고(정산서) — 거래처마스터 DC_CD 로 이어진다 SELECT 'SALE' AS gb, N'출고(정산서)' AS gbNm, ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) AS dt, LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(s.ORD_NO,''))) + CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.ORD_ITEM_NO,'') <> '' THEN '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(s.ORD_ITEM_NO)) ELSE '' END AS docNo, ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') AS place, ISNULL(s.ITEM_CD,'') AS itemCd, ISNULL(s.ITEM_NM,'') AS itemNm, ISNULL(s.OUT_QTY,0) AS qty, ISNULL(s.SALE_PRICE,0) AS price, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS amt, ISNULL(s.UNIT,'') AS remark FROM TBL_SALES_MST s CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey ) dk WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','') AND dk.dcKey <> '' AND dk.dcKey IN ( SELECT DC_CD FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(DC_CD,'') <> '' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY DC_CD HAVING MIN(VENDOR_CD) = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
UNION ALL -- ①-2 직접 판 판매전표 명세 (출고내역 탭에 함께 — 잔액의 매출이 정산서 + 이 전표라서) SELECT 'STRX', N'판매전표', ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT), ISNULL(t2.SALE_DT,'') + '-' + ISNULL(t2.SALE_NO,''), ISNULL(t2.WH_NM,''), ISNULL(d2.PROD_CD,''), ISNULL(d2.PROD_NM, N'(명세 없음)'), ISNULL(d2.QTY,0), ISNULL(d2.UNIT_PRICE,0), ISNULL(d2.TOT_AMT, t2.TOT_AMT), ISNULL(d2.REMARK, ISNULL(t2.REMARK,'')) FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_MST t2 LEFT JOIN TBL_SALES_TRX_DTL d2 ON d2.SALE_SEQ = t2.SALE_SEQ AND d2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND d2.COMP_CD = t2.COMP_CD WHERE t2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t2.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t2.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT) = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','')
UNION ALL -- ② 매입내역 — 매입전표 명세 SELECT 'PURCH', N'매입전표', m.PURCH_DT, ISNULL(m.PURCH_DT,'') + '-' + ISNULL(m.PURCH_NO,''), ISNULL(m.WH_NM,''), ISNULL(d.PROD_CD,''), ISNULL(d.PROD_NM, N'(명세 없음)'), ISNULL(d.QTY,0), ISNULL(d.UNIT_PRICE,0), ISNULL(d.TOT_AMT, m.TOT_AMT), ISNULL(d.REMARK, ISNULL(m.REMARK,'')) FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m LEFT JOIN TBL_PURCHASE_DTL d ON d.PURCH_SEQ = m.PURCH_SEQ AND d.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND d.COMP_CD = m.COMP_CD WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND m.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND m.PURCH_DT = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','')
UNION ALL -- ③④ 입금(수금)·출금(지급) 전표 — 같은 표에서 TRX_GB 로 갈린다 SELECT CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN 'RCV' ELSE 'PAY' END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN N'입금(수금)' ELSE N'출금(지급)' END, t.TRX_DT, ISNULL(t.TRX_DT,'') + '-' + ISNULL(t.TRX_NO,''), ISNULL(t.ACCT_NM, ISNULL(t.PAY_GB,'')), '', ISNULL(t.PAY_GB, N'(구분 없음)'), 0, 0, ISNULL(t.AMT,0), ISNULL(t.REMARK,'') FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND t.TRX_DT = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','') ) z ORDER BY CASE z.gb WHEN 'SALE' THEN 1 WHEN 'STRX' THEN 2 WHEN 'PURCH' THEN 3 WHEN 'RCV' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, z.docNo, z.itemCd

;WITH SRC AS ( -- ① 정산서 매출 → 출고장코드(DC_CD)로 거래처에 붙인다 (selectCustBalance 와 동일 규칙) SELECT vm.VENDOR_CD AS custCd, vm.VENDOR_NM AS custNm, ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, 0 AS saleDcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS purchDcAmt, 0 AS payAmt FROM TBL_SALES_MST s CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey ) dk JOIN ( SELECT DC_CD, MIN(VENDOR_CD) AS VENDOR_CD, MIN(VENDOR_NM) AS VENDOR_NM FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(DC_CD,'') <> '' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY DC_CD ) vm ON vm.DC_CD = dk.dcKey WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL -- ② 판매전표 SELECT t2.CUST_CD, t2.CUST_NM, ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT), ISNULL(t2.TOT_AMT,0), ISNULL(t2.DC_AMT,0), ISNULL(t2.PAY_AMT,0), 0, 0, 0 FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_MST t2 WHERE t2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t2.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
UNION ALL -- ③ 매입전표 SELECT m.VENDOR_CD, m.VENDOR_NM, m.PURCH_DT, 0, 0, 0, ISNULL(m.TOT_AMT,0), ISNULL(m.DC_AMT,0), ISNULL(m.PAY_AMT,0) FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
UNION ALL -- ④ 수금/지급 전표 SELECT t.CUST_CD, t.CUST_NM, t.TRX_DT, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.SALE_DC_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.DC_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) SELECT g.dt AS dt, g.custCd AS custCd, ISNULL(v.VENDOR_NM, g.custNm) AS custNm, ISNULL(v.VENDOR_GB,'') AS vendorGb, ISNULL(v.DC_CD,'') AS dcCd, g.saleAmt AS saleAmt, g.saleDcAmt AS saleDcAmt, g.rcvAmt AS rcvAmt, g.purchAmt AS purchAmt, g.purchDcAmt AS purchDcAmt, g.payAmt AS payAmt FROM ( -- ⓐ 조회 기간에 그날 생긴 것 SELECT x.dt AS dt, x.custCd AS custCd, MAX(x.custNm) AS custNm, SUM(x.saleAmt) AS saleAmt, SUM(x.saleDcAmt) AS saleDcAmt, SUM(x.rcvAmt) AS rcvAmt, SUM(x.purchAmt) AS purchAmt, SUM(x.purchDcAmt) AS purchDcAmt, SUM(x.payAmt) AS payAmt FROM SRC x WHERE ISNULL(x.custCd,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(x.dt,'') <> '' AND x.dt >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') AND x.dt <= REPLACE(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') GROUP BY x.dt, x.custCd
UNION ALL -- ⓑ 그 이전까지의 누계 = 전일잔액. dt 를 '00000000' 로 세워 화면이 구분한다 SELECT '00000000' AS dt, x.custCd, MAX(x.custNm), SUM(x.saleAmt), SUM(x.saleDcAmt), SUM(x.rcvAmt), SUM(x.purchAmt), SUM(x.purchDcAmt), SUM(x.payAmt) FROM SRC x WHERE ISNULL(x.custCd,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(x.dt,'') <> '' AND x.dt < REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') GROUP BY x.custCd ) g LEFT JOIN TBL_VENDOR_MST v ON v.VENDOR_CD = g.custCd AND v.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR v.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ORDER BY g.dt, g.custCd

SELECT m.SALE_SEQ AS saleSeq, m.SALE_DT AS saleDt, m.SALE_NO AS saleNo, m.DLV_DT AS dlvDt, m.CUST_CD AS custCd, m.CUST_NM AS custNm, m.MGR_CD AS mgrCd, m.MGR_NM AS mgrNm, m.WH_CD AS whCd, m.WH_NM AS whNm, m.TOT_BOX_QTY AS totBoxQty, m.TOT_EA_QTY AS totEaQty, m.TOT_QTY AS totQty, m.SUPPLY_AMT AS supplyAmt, m.VAT_AMT AS vatAmt, m.TOT_AMT AS totAmt, m.DC_AMT AS dcAmt, m.PAY_GB AS payGb, m.PAY_AMT AS payAmt, m.TAX_GB AS taxGb, m.REMARK AS remark, m.REG_DTTM AS regDttm, m.REG_USER AS regUser, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_DTL d WHERE d.SALE_SEQ = m.SALE_SEQ AND d.ACTION_YN='Y' AND d.COMP_CD = m.COMP_CD) AS prodCnt FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.SALE_DT >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.SALE_DT <= REPLACE(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.MGR_CD = #{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(m.CUST_NM,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' ) ORDER BY m.SALE_DT DESC, m.SALE_NO DESC, m.SALE_SEQ DESC

SELECT d.DTL_SEQ AS dtlSeq, d.SALE_SEQ AS saleSeq, d.ROW_NO AS rowNo, d.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, d.PROD_CD AS prodCd, d.PROD_NM AS prodNm, d.SPEC AS spec, d.PACK_QTY AS packQty, d.BOX_QTY AS boxQty, d.EA_QTY AS eaQty, d.QTY AS qty, d.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, d.AMT AS amt, d.DC_AMT AS dcAmt, d.SUPPLY_AMT AS supplyAmt, d.VAT_AMT AS vatAmt, d.TOT_AMT AS totAmt, d.SERVICE_QTY AS serviceQty, d.REMARK AS remark, d.EVENT_YN AS eventYn, d.TRX_GB AS trxGb, d.LEDGER_SEQ AS ledgerSeq FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_DTL d WHERE d.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND d.SALE_SEQ = #{saleSeq} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR d.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ORDER BY d.ROW_NO

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_SALES_TRX_MST (COMP_CD, SALE_DT, SALE_NO, DLV_DT, CUST_CD, CUST_NM, MGR_CD, MGR_NM, WH_CD, WH_NM, TOT_BOX_QTY, TOT_EA_QTY, TOT_QTY, SUPPLY_AMT, VAT_AMT, TOT_AMT, DC_AMT, PAY_GB, PAY_AMT, TAX_GB, REMARK, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'W1234567'), REPLACE(ISNULL(#{saleDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-',''), #{saleNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULLIF(REPLACE(ISNULL(#{dlvDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-',''),''), #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{custNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mgrNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{whCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{whNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{totBoxQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{totEaQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{totQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{supplyAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{vatAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{totAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dcAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{payGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{taxGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT m.SALE_DT AS spec, -- 거래일자 (화면 표시용으로 spec 칸 재사용) m.CUST_NM AS prodNm, -- 거래처 d.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, d.BOX_QTY AS boxQty, d.EA_QTY AS eaQty, d.QTY AS qty, d.AMT AS amt, d.EVENT_YN AS eventYn, d.TRX_GB AS trxGb FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_DTL d JOIN TBL_SALES_TRX_MST m ON m.SALE_SEQ = d.SALE_SEQ AND m.ACTION_YN='Y' AND m.COMP_CD = d.COMP_CD WHERE d.ACTION_YN='Y' AND d.PROD_CD = #{prodCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR d.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.CUST_CD = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND m.SALE_DT >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR,-3,GETDATE()), 112) -- 최대 3년 ORDER BY m.SALE_DT DESC, m.SALE_NO DESC
